subject_session: 5 mice (LA3, LA8, LA9, LA11, LA12), all 15 sessions; prototype sub-LA3_ses-3

justification.dataset: 000986 is the canonical Jaramillo pure-tone Neuropixels auditory-cortex dataset, an ideal choice for frequency tuning.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile+h5py+pynapple, spikes correctly aligned to tone onsets with explicit >=0.5 Hz rate filtering and sensible response/baseline windows.
justification.analysis: Kruskal-Wallis across the five frequencies is an appropriate non-parametric tuning test (frequency is ordinal, not circular), complemented by a smooth Poisson GLM that confirms the PSTH estimates.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (1426 units, 1100 tuned/77%, 562 at 8-16 kHz, latency median 11 ms IQR 3-18, 87% width<=1 octave, 128 suppressed) reproduces exactly from all_units.csv and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: PSTHs, GLM fits, the tonotopic heatmap diagonal, and population panels all clearly show the effect with labeled axes, units, and sample sizes.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to a genuinely clean, reproducible result and nothing is misrepresented, but the write-up states no specific limitation (single passive dataset, no multiple-comparison correction), keeping it at 3.
